newsitem.title: USA: Banc One slips on concerns over dilution.
newsitem.headline: Banc One slips on concerns over dilution.

text.p: Banc One Corp's share price slipped in early trading Monday on concerns about dilution from the plan to acquire First USA Inc in a $7.3 billion stock swap, traders and analysts said.
Analysts said they had not yet heard a presentation from the company so their comments were preliminary.

George Salem, analyst at Gerard Klauer Mattison, said cost savings at First USA might work out to about 25 percent of the expense basis, and on that assumption dilution to Banc Cone earnings might be about four percent.
Nancy Bush, analyst at Brown Brothers Harriman, said she was "reserving judgement" until after a Banc One briefing for analysts, expected at 1100 EST/1600 GMT.
"There are synergies, there are cost savings. I really want to hear what management has to say," she said.
Columbus, Ohio-based Banc One has a respected management team headed by Chairman and Chief Executive John McCoy, Bush said.
Banc One was off three at 42-1/8 in morning trade. First USA was up 10-3/8 at 47-1/8.
